parameters.query:
WITH stale AS ( SELECT d.submission_id FROM automacao_miller.documents d LEFT JOIN automacao_miller.processing_attempts pa ON pa.submission_id = d.submission_id AND pa.attempt_number = d.attempt_count LEFT JOIN public.execution_entity ee ON ee.id = CASE WHEN pa.execution_id ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN pa.execution_id::integer END WHERE d.status = 'em_processamento' AND d.updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '120 minutes' AND (pa.execution_id IS NULL OR ee.id IS NULL OR ee.status NOT IN ('new', 'running', 'waiting')) ), closed_attempts AS ( UPDATE automacao_miller.processing_attempts pa SET status = 'erro', current_stage = 'reconciliacao', error_category = 'infraestrutura', error_message = 'Tentativa recuperada apos timeout.', finished_at = NOW() FROM stale WHERE pa.submission_id = stale.submission_id AND pa.attempt_number = ( SELECT d.attempt_count FROM automacao_miller.documents d WHERE d.submission_id = stale.submission_id ) AND pa.status = 'em_processamento' RETURNING pa.submission_id ), reset_documents AS ( UPDATE automacao_miller.documents d SET status = 'recebido', current_stage = 'reconciliacao', updated_at = NOW(), message = 'Retomada automatica apos timeout.' FROM stale WHERE d.submission_id = stale.submission_id RETURNING d.submission_id ), pending_documents AS ( SELECT submission_id FROM reset_documents UNION SELECT submission_id FROM automacao_miller.documents WHERE status = 'recebido' )
SELECT pd.submission_id FROM pending_documents pd
JOIN automacao_miller.documents d USING (submission_id)
ORDER BY d.updated_at, pd.submission_id LIMIT 20;
